rv.q: “Silver Manhattan” succeeds on virtually every level.
Silver Manhattan is a smart business move, documentation of Malin's hard-fought journey, and a very solid rock set.
This is Holy water for your soul!
If it’s your kind of theater, it’s a kick—possibly offering one of the best nights many have spent in a theater.

cn.t: Critics praise Jesse Malin's Silver Manhattan as a powerful rock-theater hybrid that transcends the jukebox musical format, with reviewers calling it a transformative experience that blends compelling storytelling with live music.
